reviews.comment: Dr. Wood is a nice person, but a poor professor. He gives quizzes and tests that at times have borderline incoherent questions and is generally unwilling to provide feedback. He gives study guides prior to each quiz but provides no way for you to know if your answers are right. The quizlets that people have made often disagree with each other.

Not sure if this is going to be the future experience of the class because it doesn't seem to be the experience of past classes, but this class was super easy. The way he does review for the quizzes means you really don't have to watch lectures. I haven't watched a lecture past module 2 and I've got a high A. Lectures are boring, but unnecessary.

You should know that I'm dead serious when I say that this is the worst professor I've had at TAMU. He literally does not teach. He seriously just stands there and plays videos of himself teaching from a year ago. He altered the schedule so that we only see him in person half as much as we used to. This man wastes your time. Don't let him.

Pretty much everything else anyone has said about him. Hes not a good professor at all and does not help his students. His lectures are unclear with cloudy wording and then questions are extremely specific. He is rude and condescending if you ask for help. This is my 5th year at A&M and he is, without reservation, the worst professor Ive ever had
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Horrible prof. Unhelpful outside of class, spend all of the next class after a quiz everyone failed to talk about how dumb we are. Will ask for advice about how to make the class better then, when given suggestions, will say he is unwilling to do that. Some quiz questions have upwards of 7 answers choices, just not a good or helpful professor

9% of students got one of his questions right and he said he was not going to give points back for it because the question was a good one, even though only 9% of students in the whole class got it right. That's 2 students. He is a horrible professor, assigns way too much, one of his questions had 7 answer choices. He is the worst professor I've had

Quite possibly the worst professor I have had in my four years at A&M. He is a double whammy of being an incompetent professor and an extremely hard grader. Maybe it's because we are all online, but he gives us 5 videos with 40 slides of just paragraphs and 5 separate readings and then asks extremely specific questions. He just reads off the slides

Alright, I am one of the odd kids that goes to college to LEARN. This class taught me NOTHING. Literally went to class every day, lecture slides were novels and the font was too small to read. Does not help you with exam studying. Very rude outside of class. I have no idea how in the hell he is still a professor. DO NOT TAKE WOOD.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures are absolutely boring, but you have to attend because he takes attendance. He will give you test questions before the test, but you will not be able to ask him any questions over if you think you have the right answer or not. You have to do a bibliography and anything you try to cite he has written, just take that into consideration.
Very boring professor. He reads straight from the PowerPoint and his assignments are very dull and inspire no real provoking thought. Literally just a read a memorize course.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Wood was one of the best professors I have had at Texas A&M.  Always answered my questions in class and graded me fairly.  He gives three extra points on your final average if you attend all of his classes so there is an incentive to go.  Not sure why he has low ratings on here.  I learned a lot the two semesters I had him.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Reads straight from the powerpoint, which he provides to you so going to class is almost pointless. Takes strict attendance and if you miss class you have to fill out a form. He belittles you if you ask questions and rarely answers them. Midterm, Final, and a 17 sourced annotated bib. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!! SAVE YOURSELF.

Took this guy for 2 classes a semester (POLS 319). Big mistake. Same structure, different material. 2 Exams, 1 annotated bibliography. He posts the study questions 1 week before the test and chooses 50 out of 100-150. Work with others (google doc) to get a decent grade on this. The material is simple enough but he grades inconsistently.

His lectures are extremely boring and read directly from powerpoint slides. He gives extra credit for perfect attendance, so that's the only incentive to attend class. Grading is inconsistent, vague, and when you address any questions to him outside of class he blows you off. Work with classmates on the study guides to get a good grade in here.

Dr. Wood does not know how to lecture well. All of his slides are online, and he reads straight from the slides. However, he requires you to be in class. If you miss 6, you're "fired" (AKA you fail). Definitely read his book before you take the test, because it's the book he wrote that has the answers. He's a bit of a narcissist, so use his books.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
